name: AudioVoiceListDecode
signature: void AudioVoiceListDecode(AudioVoiceList* l, void* sinks, u32 nSinks, u32 frames)
description: locks list (+28h/+30h), then AudioVoiceDecodeBlock for each voice with flags +28h&2 set and (flags&14h)!=4 (not paused); no audibility/volume test before decoding

name: ConvReverbProcess
signature: u64 ConvReverbProcess(float** ch, u32 frames, ReverbFx* fx, ConvIR* ir, ConvState* st)
description: FIFO-chunks input into a 3-block ring and runs ConvReverbPartitionMac per channel once a full block is queued; only skips when BOTH previous and target wet gain < 0.0001 (iVar7==2); never checks for silent input

name: AudioReverbEffectProcess
signature: u32 AudioReverbEffectProcess(Effect* e, u32 ch, u32 frames, float* buf)
description: effect process entry: deinterleave, optional pre-filter (388DE48/388E410), ConvReverbProcess, delay line, 5-tap biquad per channel

name: AudioFft2N
description: forward FFT of size 2n used by the convolution reverb; core kernel E7D00

name: AudioFftKernel
description: 3.8 KB FFT butterfly kernel, only caller AudioFft2N

name: AudioEffectChainProcess
description: caller of E2340 per-effect process; only caller 36044C; 7.6 % inclusive on the audio thread

name: AudioEffectChainEntry
description: wrapper around AudioEffectChainProcess on the mix thread
